name: categories
title: Categories
description: Paginated product-category listing: Root, Grid, Card and Pagination. Root is context-aware — headless when given a `categories` array, otherwise it fetches a page from the sveltekit-medusa-sdk categories remote, optionally filtered to one parent (`parentId`) for the subcategories-on-a-category-page case. Card links to /categories/<handle> by default (string or builder `href`) and reads its image from `metadata.thumbnail` — configurable via `imageKey`, overridable via an `image` snippet — since Medusa categories have no image field; it degrades to a text-only card when the key is absent. Grid defaults to 1/2/3/4 columns at base/md/lg/xl with a per-item snippet override and an `empty` slot. The page lives in the URL as a 1-based `?p=` param. No $effect (SSR-safe).
